module rtlpp_08977 (
                       address,
                       byteenable,
                       chipselect,
                       clk,
                       clken,
                       write,
                       writedata,
                       readdata
                     );

  output  [31:0] readdata;
  input   [9:0] address;
  input   [3:0] byteenable;
  input         chipselect;
  input         clk;
  input         clken;
  input         write;
  input   [31:0] writedata;

  reg [31:0] mem [0:1023];
  reg [31:0] readdata;
  wire       wren;
  integer    i;
  
  assign wren = chipselect & write;
  
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (clken) begin
      if (wren) begin
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1) begin
          if (byteenable[i]) begin
            mem[address][i*8 +: 8] <= writedata[i*8 +: 8];
          end
        end
      end
      readdata <= mem[address];
    end
  end

endmodule
